title: Banking System
shortDesc: Admin & user software with OTP, facial recognition, multi-language, and account management.
longDesc:
Admin & user software with OTP, facial recognition, multi-language support, account management, and printing. Built with C#, SQLServer, and C++.

Key Features:
• Separate interfaces for Administrator and User
• Account approval workflow
• Transaction history with filters
• Multi-language support (English, Filipino, Spanish)
• Security: Email verification, OTP, Security Key, Facial Recognition
• Account management with deactivation
• Printable transaction summaries
